title: 1.1 Definition and Nature of Physics
description: Definition and Nature of Physics concepts and applications. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A team designs a brake system and a medical scanner. Which single subject supplies the underlying principles for both?
options: Physics
Biology
Geology
Literature
questions.correctAnswer: Physics

questions.question: A student claims that physics is only about formulas. Which textbook-based response is strongest?
options: Physics also explains everyday phenomena and devices now
Formulas are the only real content of science in physics
Physics has no links to technology still in the textbook
Physics avoids experiments entirely here in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Physics also explains everyday phenomena and devices now

questions.question: Which pair of examples best illustrates physics improving quality of life?
options: Computer tomography and magnetic resonance imaging
Bone classification and seed germination in nature
Plant taxonomy and animal behavior in the textbook
Historical chronology and grammar rules in physics
questions.correctAnswer: Computer tomography and magnetic resonance imaging

questions.question: An engineer checks structural stability, acoustics and cooling for a new building. Which field is being applied?
options: Engineering
Medical physics
Geophysics
Biophysics
questions.correctAnswer: Engineering

questions.question: A researcher uses radioactive dating and earthquake analysis. Which field best describes the work?
options: Geology
Astrophysics
Acoustics
Optics
questions.correctAnswer: Geology

questions.question: Which statement distinguishes biophysics from geophysics?
options: Biophysics studies biological systems; geophysics studies the Earth
Biophysics studies the Earth; geophysics studies living cells still
Both study only the weather as well in the textbook of this subject
Both study only atomic nuclei still in the textbook of this subject
questions.correctAnswer: Biophysics studies biological systems; geophysics studies the Earth

questions.question: A hospital uses x-rays, MRI and ultrasonic blood flow measurements. Which field covers these applications?
options: Medical physics
Nuclear physics
Meteorology
Metrology
questions.correctAnswer: Medical physics

questions.question: Which historical shift marks the beginning of modern physics?
options: Revolutionary discoveries in the early twentieth century
The invention of the printing press here in the textbook
The founding of the first universities now in this topic
The discovery of agriculture for students in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Revolutionary discoveries in the early twentieth century

questions.question: Which statement about classical and modern physics is accurate?
options: Many classical laws were modified during the twentieth century now
Modern physics completely discarded every classical law in physics
Classical physics began in the twentieth century now in this topic
The two terms describe the same period for students in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Many classical laws were modified during the twentieth century now

questions.question: A scientist formulates laws of motion and explains planetary orbits with gravitation. Who is being described?
options: Isaac Newton
Michael Faraday
Marie Curie
Albert Einstein
questions.correctAnswer: Isaac Newton

questions.question: A scientist produced mechanical motion with a magnet and current, then built the first electric generator. Who is being described?
options: Michael Faraday
James Prescott Joule
Marie Curie
Isaac Newton
questions.correctAnswer: Michael Faraday

questions.question: A scientist linked heat to mechanical work and helped establish energy conservation. Who is being described?
options: James Prescott Joule
Albert Einstein here
Michael Faraday here
Marie Curie in class
questions.correctAnswer: James Prescott Joule

questions.question: A scientist pioneered radioactivity research and discovered polonium and radium. Who is being described?
options: Marie Curie
Isaac Newton
James Prescott Joule
Michael Faraday
questions.correctAnswer: Marie Curie

questions.question: A scientist developed relativity and contributed to quantum mechanics. Who is being described?
options: Albert Einstein
Michael Faraday
Marie Curie
Isaac Newton
questions.correctAnswer: Albert Einstein

questions.question: Galileos leaning-tower experiment is best summarized by which result?
options: Objects fall at the same rate regardless of mass
Heavier objects always land first in experiments
Gravity acts only on light objects in this topic
Falling bodies stop accelerating in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Objects fall at the same rate regardless of mass

questions.question: Which contributor is correctly paired with an achievement?
options: Faraday - first electric generator
Curie - laws of motion in the unit
Joule - theory of relativity still
Newton - discovery of radium still
questions.correctAnswer: Faraday - first electric generator

questions.question: Which contributor is correctly paired with work on heat?
options: Joule - relationship between heat and mechanical work
Einstein - first electric generator now in this topic
Faraday - radioactive elements as well in experiments
Newton - quantum mechanics only still in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Joule - relationship between heat and mechanical work

questions.question: A student argues that physics has no role in biology. Which example is the best counter-evidence?
options: Physical methods are used to study biological phenomena
Plants must be watered daily in physics in the textbook
Animals reproduce still in the textbook of this subject
Cells contain genetic material in class in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Physical methods are used to study biological phenomena

questions.question: Which situation depends on metrology rather than meteorology?
options: Checking that a measured kilogram is reliable now
Forecasting weather for tomorrow now for students
Tracking the path of a storm here in the textbook
Measuring atmospheric pressure changes in physics
questions.correctAnswer: Checking that a measured kilogram is reliable now

questions.question: Which statement best explains why physics knowledge changes over time?
options: New discoveries lead to revised and refined laws
Laws of physics are chosen by popular vote
Physics stops changing once a law is written
Every new idea invalidates all earlier knowledge
questions.correctAnswer: New discoveries lead to revised and refined laws
